description: Establishment of a Sri Lanka Consulate General in Guangzhou, China
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2011-08-17
decision_details_body: -  the proposal made by Hon. (Prof.) G.L. Peiris, Minister of External Affairs, for the establishment of a Consulate General Guangzhou, China, to facilitate trade, investment and tourism promotions in Southern China, was approved by the Cabinet.
